gumtree_entries.description: ADDED i9: Verifies that round-tripping between a proleptic year and its era-based representation (era + year-of-era) is consistent for every year in [-200, 200). Pax era
ADDED i10: BCE covers proleptic years <= 0; CE covers proleptic years > 0
ADDED i11: Year-of-era always counts from 1 within an era: CE proleptic year Y → yoe = Y BCE proleptic year Y (≤ 0) → yoe = 1 - Y (so year 0 → yoe 1, year -1 → yoe 2, …)
ADDED i12: Reconstructing the date from (era, yearOfEra) must yield the same date
